title: Can resize panel applets in invalid directions with win+rmb
line: Meta+right-dragging an applet popup no longer pulls it over its panel or away from the screen edge it sits against.
explanation: KWin's Meta+right-drag resize picks which edges to move only from where the pointer is in the window. Applet popups are placed by Plasma against their panel (and sometimes a screen edge), and their own resize handles leave those edges out, but KWin's resize didn't, so dragging near the panel side grew the popup over the panel. While a resize is running KWin also ignores the popup's position updates, so it stayed detached. For applet popups, KWin now drops the edges that face the nearest panel or touch the screen edge from Meta+right-drag (and the keyboard resize shortcut); if no edge is left, nothing is resized.

commits.message:
window: don't resize applet popups away from their panel with Meta+RMB

Meta+right-drag picked the edges to resize from the pointer position
only, so an applet popup could be pulled over its panel or away from the
screen edge it sits against. Those edges are now left out for popups.

BUG: 507821

media.caption: Kickoff after Meta+right-dragging its bottom-left corner down by 50 px: the popup now covers the panel.
Same drag with the fix: the bottom edge stays on the panel; only the free left edge moved.

review.text: The fix guesses the popup's panel as the nearest dock on the same output and locks the edge facing it. That heuristic is fragile: popups of applets on the desktop (also AppletPopup) would get an edge locked toward an unrelated panel, multiple panels on one output can pick the wrong one, and floating margins aren't handled (as the after shot shows). KWin should get the real attachment from the client rather than infer it.
changes: In libplasma, set the popup's transient parent (the panel/containment window) before its surface is created so KWin's transientFor is valid, and use the parent's geometry in KWin instead of searching for the nearest dock; or add an explicit allowed/locked-edges hint to the plasma-shell surface (plasma-wayland-protocols + libplasma + kwin).
If that is too much for this bug, the simpler acceptable alternative is to not offer Meta+RMB (and keyboard) resize for applet popups at all, leaving resizing to their own handles.
